subject: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools
messages:
From: Elena Koval <elena.koval@orion-ai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Partnerships <partnerships@orion-ai.com>, Mike Han <mike.han@devtools.co>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools

Hi Sergio — great to connect last week. Our partnerships team (cc'd) is excited to explore a short, hands-on demo workshop we can co-host the first week of September. High-level goals: 1) showcase a combined workflow (Orion ingestion -> Redwood inference -> DevTools observability), 2) generate 300–500 qualified leads, and 3) build a replayable workshop that we can syndicate.

Initial asks from our side: a 30–40 minute joint session + a 10–15 minute live Q&A; a 1 pager and social kit for amplification; and a joint follow-up checklist for registrants. Can you share your available dates and a rough run of show?

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, OrionAI

--
OrionAI | Driving smarter data pipelines
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Koval <elena.koval@orion-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools

Elena — love this. Thanks for the clear goals. Quick replies inline: 

- Format & length: 30–40 + 10 Q&A works. We recommend a 3-block flow: 1) context & problem (5m), 2) integrated demo (20m), 3) customer example + call to action (10m), Q&A last.
- Target metrics: 300–500 registrants sounds reasonable if we co-promote (email + LinkedIn + partner newsletter). Redwood will commit to two email sends and a sponsored LinkedIn post.
- Assets: Redwood can produce the social kit and a landing page; can you own the promo to your customer newsletter?

Notes: We should involve DevTools early for observability screenshots and a short segment. Mike Han (cc) — can you confirm availability for demo prep? Marissa — can you draft a rough landing page copy and request a template from Growth? Vanessa — can you handle speaker logistics? Stephanie — I'll book a follow-up sync with Orion/DevTools this week.

I'll attach a quick agenda draft. If that looks good, we can lock dates.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW-Orion-demo-agenda-v2.pdf
From: Mike Han <mike.han@devtools.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Elena Koval <elena.koval@orion-ai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools

Sergio / Elena — thanks for the ping. Mike here from DevTools. Available for prep on Wed/Thu this week (PDT). We'll provide a short 5–7 minute segment showing how our tracing surface catches model regressions and latency spikes in the combined demo. Also happy to contribute a small observability checklist to the collateral.

Question: will the demo use live inference or recorded traffic? We recommend recorded traffic for reliability during the event, with a live 'sanity check' at the end.

—Mike
Head of Product Partnerships, DevTools Co.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Koval <elena.koval@orion-ai.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools

Elena — thanks, and hi everyone. I've drafted the landing page copy and a short promotional calendar. Key things we still need: a short customer quote or use case from Orion, headshot + bio for each speaker, and the preferred registrant CTA (trial credit, ebook, or consult slot). Attached is the co-marketing brief with our proposed distribution plan.

Draft timeline suggestion: 
- Aug 4: finalize agenda & speaker list
- Aug 18: open registration
- Sep 2: rehearsal + assets check
- Sep 8: live workshop

I've attached the co-marketing brief and the agenda. Feedback welcome.

Thanks,
Marissa
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: co-marketing-brief-2026Q3.docx
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Koval <elena.koval@orion-ai.com>, Mike Han <mike.han@devtools.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-marketing sprint: Rapid Demos workshop with OrionAI & DevTools

All — quick operational points after reviewing the assets: 

1) Dates: Sep 8 works for us. Elena — can you confirm Orion's speaker availability for Sep 8 and the rehearsal on Sep 2?
2) Demo plan: we'll use recorded inference traffic for the main demo; live sanity check at the end as Mike suggested.
3) Promo cadence: Redwood will send two emails (announce + reminder) and run a 1-week paid LinkedIn push starting Aug 25. Orion to send one newsletter mention on Aug 27. DevTools to publish a short blog post the week before.
4) Registrant CTA: Redwood suggests a trial credit + invite to a 1:1 consult with a Solutions Engineer — converts higher historically.

Next steps: Elena to confirm speakers & any customer quote by Jul 20. Marissa to finalize landing copy and share Drive link. Vanessa to own speaker logistics + calendar invites. I'll set the rehearsal meeting once speakers are confirmed.

Thanks team — excited to get this across the finish line.

Best,
Sergio
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
